description: This file defines database initialization, index creation, and database connection management for a FastAPI application using MongoDB via Motor. It includes functions for setting up database indexes, an async context manager for application lifespan events, and a dependency to access the database within request handlers.

methods.name: None _init_indexes(db)
methods.description: Creates indexes on the 'players' and 'games' collections in the MongoDB database.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[None,None] lifespan(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Async context manager that manages initialization and shutdown of the MongoDB client during FastAPI application lifespan.

methods.name: Any get_db(request: Request)
methods.description: Provides access to the MongoDB database handle within FastAPI request lifecycle.
